name: zed

edits.disables: Zed client crash diagnostics. Preserve the existing telemetry object and unrelated settings.
Zed client usage metrics, including high-level AI-feature interactions. Hosted-service billing/rate-limit metadata is separate.

commands.win32: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command 'try { $running = Get-Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match "^(zed)$" }; if ($running) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 2 }'

process_check.if_running: Quit Zed before external settings edits so an in-app settings write cannot replace the change; verify both telemetry settings after restarting.

manual_only_items.name: Edit Prediction training data
manual_only_items.ui_path: Zed's Edit Prediction status bar menu → Privacy → Training Data Collection: turn OFF if previously enabled; verify the toggle in the UI. This is separate from the telemetry settings.
manual_only_items.reason: Official documentation says training collection is opt-in and the UI control is the supported opt-out. Do not invent a settings.json training key.

manual_only_items.name: AI response ratings and feedback
manual_only_items.ui_path: Do not rate or submit AI conversations if you do not want those threads persisted by Zed. On Zed Business, administrators can additionally restrict feedback/training participation through organization Data Sharing controls.
manual_only_items.reason: Each feedback submission explicitly shares a thread. telemetry.metrics=false does not revoke past feedback, erase retained data or suppress essential hosted-model requests.

persistent_files.note: User settings for the current platform; Linux honors XDG_CONFIG_HOME with ~/.config as its standard fallback. Zed supports JSON comments. Resolve Flatpak or --user-data-dir overrides through the app before interpreting a missing default-path file. Report only.

Editor logs for the current platform; Linux honors XDG_DATA_HOME with ~/.local/share as its standard fallback. Flatpak and custom data roots may use another location, which must be resolved from the app. Report only; never delete logs.

notes: The two telemetry keys are real nested JSON properties, not literal dotted-name settings. Preserve JSON comments and other telemetry members while changing only diagnostics and metrics.

Resolve the actual user settings file before editing: Linux honors XDG_CONFIG_HOME; Flatpak builds can use FLATPAK_XDG_CONFIG_HOME; --user-data-dir changes the config root to <selected-directory>/config. Use Zed's Open Settings File command when an override is present, and do not create the default file instead.

Only client diagnostics/metrics are disabled. Zed-hosted AI and collaboration retain essential server-side metadata; external agents and provider API keys have their own policies. Review AI privacy docs for provider-specific retention exceptions.
For installations without a zed launcher (or nonstandard/prerelease bundles), verify the app in its installed location rather than treating leftover ~/.config/zed settings as proof of installation.
